use default

use STEP = (order: List[int], sign: int)

swap(values: LIST[int], left: int, right: int) is
    (values[left], values[right]) = (values[right], values[left])
si

permutations(size: int) -> Pipe[STEP] is
    let values = (1::size) |> collect_list()
    let facing = (1::size) |> map(_ => -1) |> collect_list()
    let sign mut = 1

    do
        yield (order = values |> collect(), sign = sign)

        let mobile mut = 0
        let position mut = -1

        for index in 0..size do
            let target = index + facing[index]

            if target >= 0 /\ target < size /\
                values[index] > values[target] /\
                values[index] > mobile then
                mobile = values[index]
                position = index
            fi
        od

        if position < 0 then break fi

        swap(values, position, position + facing[position])
        swap(facing, position, position + facing[position])

        for index in 0..size do
            if values[index] > mobile then
                facing[index] = -facing[index]
            fi
        od

        sign = -sign
    od
